'''Longbows''' were primitive weapons used normally by archaic peoples with no [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] technology.

==Description==
The longbows fired small arrow-like projectiles, known as [[Spear/Legends|spears]] or bolts. The longbow needed to be reloaded after each shot and had a slow rate of fire, although the hitting power and accuracy of this weapon was not to be underestimated.<ref name="TRG1" /> Because of its size, longbows could be cumbersome to carry even close quarters or over great distances, especially when meter-long arrows and quiver were carried as well. While an uncommon sight in the greater galaxy, on primitive worlds like [[Weik/Legends|Weik]], they were common.<ref name="NoP" />

==History==
Mostly primitive [[Species/Legends|species]], like the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] used this weapon.<ref name="TRG1" />
